description: Parking PCNs Appeals Outcome Letters is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Lincolnshire County Council. This dataset shows the number of letters sent for outcomes of appeals for Penalty Charge Notices (PCNs) issued in on-street parking areas throughout Lincolnshire. Outcomes of appeals are shown in categories along with the number of letters sent in each category. Coverage: Lincolnshire County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Lincolnshire County Council. Its tags are cpe, fine, highways, parking, transparency. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
